headline: Bitcoin Options Skew Fell to 9.28 into the Oct. 15 Expiry
narrative: Bitcoin options skew fell to 9.28 from 16.02 into the Oct. 15 expiry, with the 77k put still bid against the 93k call. The options pipe is the price of downside protection versus upside calls, and the gap narrowed, so less premium is bid for a drop while puts still hold the premium. Bitcoin changed hands near 84k, up 0.40 percent, so the cheaper hedge arrived with the price higher, not in a selloff.
author: jordan
